svg.title: Career: revision history from mechanical engineering (2015) to ML platforms (2026)
svg.desc: Timeline drawn as a chain dimension from 2015 to 2026 with revision triangles, and a revision history table, latest first. Rev J, JUL 2026 – NOW, FREDDIE MAC, Finance · ML forecasting: Rejoined as a senior backend engineer: FastAPI microservices on AWS EKS/ECS that serve machine-learning models for large-scale forecasting. Rev H, MAY 2025 – JUL 2026, CAPITAL ONE, Finance · card portfolio decisioning: Platform of 50+ AWS microservices. Event-driven serverless pipeline: EventBridge → Lambda → DynamoDB Streams → Step Functions → Glue/Spark. React/TS + Python; Vitest/RTL, Playwright BDD, feature-flagged rollouts. Rev G, JAN 2023 – MAY 2025, FREDDIE MAC, Finance · ML forecasting: Led the backend team. Refactored a 3,000-line Python backend to ~1,000 lines (+20% performance); PyTest coverage above 85%; Tableau deployment from PoC to production; built a local RAG system. Rev F, APR 2022 – JAN 2023, AGERO, Serverless data sync: FastAPI on AWS Lambda from scratch. S3 events → EventBridge → Lambda → MongoDB data sync; GitHub Actions CI/CD; React job dashboard. Rev E, MAY 2019 – APR 2022, HUMANA, Healthcare · specialty pharmacy: Led the backend agile team. Tesseract OCR services in Flask integrated with .NET apps; Django; React. Rev D, JUN 2018 – MAY 2019, McKESSON, Pharma SaaS: Flask + MS SQL; Angular + C# Web API; an Express/Node portal built test-first (TDD). Rev C, SEP 2017 – MAY 2018, WOOLWORTHS, Retail · Sydney: ASP.NET / C# N-tier modules; Azure App Insights monitoring; Sev-1 incident response. Rev B, JAN 2016 – AUG 2017, CVS HEALTH, Pharmacy apps: Led API development. AngularJS single-page app from scratch on Web API + SQL Server. Rev A, 2015, ANNA UNIVERSITY, BE Mechanical Engineering: The origin story: from gears to graphs.
svg.text: 10+ years, 5 domains · flags mark led teams · rev letters skip I and O, per drafting practice
